answer.rationale: Use targeted promotional pricing only for a narrowly defined, price-sensitive SMB segment to address the immediate competitor-driven churn risk. Memory_73 shows strong acquisition and revenue lift but materially worse 30-day retention, so a broad rollout would conflict with sustainable qualified revenue. Run a guarded test with retention and qualified-revenue stop criteria; onboarding and activation improvements can support value realization but are less immediate as a competitive price response.
